entries.name: Bayonet
entries.summary: The weapon can be used in melee as a light melee weapon. It cannot be hidden under clothes.

entries.name: Drum magazine
entries.summary: Holds more rounds (see the magazine table); only one magazine per weapon. The weapon cannot be hidden.

entries.name: Extended magazine
entries.summary: Holds more rounds (see the magazine table); only one magazine per weapon. The weapon cannot be hidden.

entries.name: Underbarrel grenade launcher
entries.summary: Held in two hands the weapon can be used as a grenade launcher with 1 grenade in the underbarrel. Cannot be hidden. Takes 2 slots.

entries.name: Infrared night-vision scope
entries.summary: Removes penalties for darkness, smoke, fog and the like; shows body heat, but not which cyberware the target has.

entries.name: Underbarrel shotgun
entries.summary: Held in two hands the weapon can be used as a shotgun with a 2-round magazine. Cannot be hidden. Takes 2 slots.

entries.name: Smartlink connector
entries.summary: Makes the weapon smart: +1 to hit on a ranged attack. Needs special cyberware (an interface plug or a subdermal smartlink plus a neurolink); installing or removing takes an hour. Takes 2 slots.

entries.name: Sniper scope
entries.summary: Lets you see details up to 800 m; +1 to the check on a single or aimed shot at 51 m or farther. Does not stack with the TeleOptics implant.
